Container.Name: HolyArrs
Container.Overview:
HolyArrs is one app that does the job of Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr and Seerr.
Browse shows, movies and music like a streaming service, with Top 10s, trailers, new releases and what's coming soon, then request in one tap. Family and friends can request too, and you approve or let it run.
HolyArrs finds the best release from your sources, sends it to qBittorrent, SABnzbd or the downloader you already run, grabs subtitles, renames and files it, and Plex, Jellyfin or Emby picks it up. It also has a calendar of upcoming episodes, import from your existing Sonarr and Radarr, TRaSH guide sync, Plex watchlist requests and 16 languages.
One 15 MB image, about 70 MB RAM idle, no OS inside.
Beta: run it next to your current setup until it has proven itself on yours.
Unraid tips: keep /config on a direct pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/holyarrs, not /mnt/user. For hardlinks, map one share that holds both your downloads and your library folders.
Container.Requires: A downloader such as qBittorrent or SABnzbd. Plex, Jellyfin or Emby to watch.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Use a direct pool path, not /mnt/user. HolyArrs gives this folder to PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Optional. Names you open HolyArrs by besides its IP, comma-separated, for example tower.local.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission bits new files leave out. 002 lets the group write.
